<h1 id="maomimapper">Maomi.Mapper</h1>
<p>注：本项目用于教学目的，性能较差，请勿用于生产环境。</p>
<p>仓库地址：<a href="https://github.com/whuanle/Maomi.Mapper" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/whuanle/Maomi.Mapper</a></p>
<p>MaomiMapper 是一个使用表达式树构造生成对象成员映射的框架，即对象映射框架。</p>
<p>虽然 MaomiMapper 性能不啥样，但是代码注释也写得很齐全，适合读者研究反射、表达式树、类型转换等代码。</p>
<p>MaomiMapper 与  AutoMapper 对比：</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>

<blockquote>
<p>AS 开头的方法表示有类型转换。</p>
</blockquote>
<p>测试使用的模型类：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">	public class TestValue
	{
		public bool ValueA { get; set; } = true;
		public sbyte ValueB { get; set; } = 1;
		public byte ValueC { get; set; } = 2;
		public short ValueD { get; set; } = 3;
		public ushort ValueE { get; set; } = 4;
		public int ValueF { get; set; } = 5;
		public uint ValueG { get; set; } = 6;
		public long ValueH { get; set; } = 7;
		public ulong ValueI { get; set; } = 8;
		public float ValueJ { get; set; } = 9;
		public double ValueK { get; set; } = 10;
		public decimal ValueL { get; set; } = 11;
		public char ValueM { get; set; } = (Char)12;
	}
	public class TestB
	{
		public bool ValueA { get; set; } = true;
		public sbyte ValueB { get; set; } = 1;
		public byte ValueC { get; set; } = 2;
		public short ValueD { get; set; } = 3;
		public ushort ValueE { get; set; } = 4;
		public int ValueF { get; set; } = 5;
		public uint ValueG { get; set; } = 6;
		public long ValueH { get; set; } = 7;
		public ulong ValueI { get; set; } = 8;
		public float ValueJ { get; set; } = 9;
		public double ValueK { get; set; } = 10;
		public decimal ValueL { get; set; } = 11;
		public char ValueM { get; set; } = (Char)12;
	}
	public class TestBase&lt;T&gt;
	{
		public T ValueA { get; set; }
		public T ValueB { get; set; }
		public T ValueC { get; set; }
		public T ValueD { get; set; }
		public T ValueE { get; set; }
		public T ValueF { get; set; }
		public T ValueG { get; set; }
		public T ValueH { get; set; }
		public T ValueI { get; set; }
		public T ValueJ { get; set; }
		public T ValueK { get; set; }
		public T ValueL { get; set; }
	}

	public class TestC : TestBase&lt;int&gt; { }

	public class TestD
	{
		public bool ValueA { get; set; } = true;
		public sbyte ValueB { get; set; } = 1;
		public byte ValueC { get; set; } = 2;
		public short ValueD { get; set; } = 3;
		public ushort ValueE { get; set; } = 4;
		public int ValueF { get; set; } = 5;
		public uint ValueG { get; set; } = 6;
		public long ValueH { get; set; } = 7;
		public ulong ValueI { get; set; } = 8;
		public float ValueJ { get; set; } = 9;
		public double ValueK { get; set; } = 10;
		public decimal ValueL { get; set; } = 11;
		public char ValueM { get; set; } = (Char)12;
	}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="快速使用-maomimapper">快速使用 MaomiMapper</h3>
<p>MaomiMapper 框架的使用比较简单，示例如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var maomi = new MaomiMapper();
maomi
    .Bind&lt;TestValue, TestB&gt;()
    .Bind&lt;TestValue, TestC&gt;()
    .Bind&lt;TestValue, TestD&gt;();

maomi.Map&lt;TestValue, TestD&gt;(new TestValue());
</code></pre>
<h3 id="配置">配置</h3>
<p>在映射对象时，可以配置映射逻辑，比如碰到成员是对象时，是否开辟新对象，是否映射私有成员等。</p>
<p>使用方法如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">        var mapper = new MaomiMapper();
        mapper.Bind&lt;TestA, TestB&gt;(option =&gt;
        {
            option.IsObjectReference = false;
        }).Build();
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>每个类型映射都可以单独配置一个 MapOption。</p>
</blockquote>
<p>MapOption 类型：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">	/// &lt;summary&gt;
	/// 映射配置
	/// &lt;/summary&gt;
	public class MapOption
	{
		/// &lt;summary&gt;
		/// 包括私有字段
		/// &lt;/summary&gt;
		public bool IncludePrivate { get; set; } = false;

		/// &lt;summary&gt;
		/// 自动映射，如果有字段/属性没有配置映射规则，则自动映射
		/// &lt;/summary&gt;
		public bool AutoMap { get; set; } = true;

		/// &lt;summary&gt;
		/// 如果属性字段是对象且为相同类型，则保持引用。 &lt;br /&gt;
		/// 如果设置为 false，则会创建新的对象，再对字段逐个处理。
		/// &lt;/summary&gt;
		public bool IsObjectReference { get; set; } = true;

		/// &lt;summary&gt;
		/// 配置时间转换器。&lt;br /&gt;
		///  如果 b.Value 是 DateTime，而 a.Value 不是 DateTime，则需要配置转换器，否则会报错。
		/// &lt;/summary&gt;
		/// &lt;value&gt;&lt;/value&gt;
		public Func&lt;object, DateTime&gt;? ConvertDateTime { get; set; }
	}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="自动扫描">自动扫描</h3>
<p>MaomiMapper 支持扫描程序集中的对象映射，有两种方法可以配置。</p>
<p>第一种方法是使用特性类，标识该类型可以转换为何种类型。</p>
<p>如下代码所示，TestValueB 标识了其可以映射为 TestValueA 类型。</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">	public class TestValueA
	{
		public string ValueA { get; set; } = "A";

		public string ValueB { get; set; } = "B";

		public string ValueC { get; set; } = "C";
	}

	[Map(typeof(TestValueA), IsReverse = true)]
	public class TestValueB
	{
		public string ValueA { get; set; }

		public string ValueB { get; set; }

		public string ValueC { get; set; }
	}
</code></pre>
<p>第二种方法是实现 IMapper，在文件中配置映射规则。</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">	public class MyMapper : IMapper
	{
		public override void Bind(MaomiMapper mapper)
		{
			mapper.Bind&lt;TestA, TestC&gt;(option =&gt; option.IsObjectReference = false);
			mapper.Bind&lt;TestA, TestD&gt;(option =&gt; option.IsObjectReference = false);
		}
	}
</code></pre>
<p>此外，可以继承实现 MapOptionAttribute 特性，然后附加到类型中，在扫描程序集映射时，框架会自动配置。</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = false)]
	public class MyMapOptionAttribute : MapOptionAttribute
	{
		public override Action&lt;MapOption&gt; MapOption =&gt; _option;
		private Action&lt;MapOption&gt; _option;
		public MyMapOptionAttribute()
		{
			_option = option =&gt;
			{
				option.IsObjectReference = false;
			};
		}
	}

	[MyMapOption]
	[Map(typeof(TestB), IsReverse = true)]
	public class TestA
	{
		public string ValueA { get; set; } = "A";

		public string ValueB { get; set; } = "B";

		public string ValueC { get; set; } = "C";
		public TestValueA Value { get; set; }
	}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="配置字段映射">配置字段映射</h3>
<p>可以使用 <code>.Map</code> 配置一个字段的映射规则。</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">maomi
    .Bind&lt;TestValue, TestB&gt;()
    .Map(a =&gt; a.ValueC + 1, b =&gt; b.ValueC).Build()
</code></pre>
<p>相当于：</p>
<pre><code>b.ValueC = a.ValueC + 1
</code></pre>
<p>如果有私有字段需要映射，可以使用名称字段。</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">    public class TestD
    {
        public string ValueA { get; set; }
        public string ValueB;
        private string ValueC { get; set; }
        private string ValueD;
    }

    public class TestDD
    {
        public string ValueA { get; set; }
        public string ValueB;
        public string ValueC { get; set; }
        public string ValueD;
    }
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">        var mapper = new MaomiMapper();
        var build = mapper.Bind&lt;TestC, TestD&gt;(
            option =&gt;
            {
                option.IncludePrivate = true;
            })
            .Map(a =&gt; "111", b =&gt; "ValueC")
            .Build();
        mapper.Bind&lt;TestC, TestDD&gt;().Build();
</code></pre>
<p>相当于：</p>
<pre><code>b.ValueC = "111"
</code></pre>
<p>在配置映射时，可以调用 <code>Build()</code> 方法，自动映射其它字段或属性。比如开发者只配置了 <code>.ValueA</code> 属性，未配置 <code>ValueB</code>、<code>ValueC</code> 等，则调用 <code>Build()</code> 时，框架会补全其它属性对应的映射。如果未配置，框架则在第一次使用对象映射时自动调用。</p>
<p>如果需要反向映射，可以使用 <code>BuildAndReverse()</code>。</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">           .BuildAndReverse(option =&gt;
			{
				option.IsObjectReference = false;
			});
</code></pre>
<p>可以忽略字段映射。</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">				// b.V = a.V + "a"
				.Map(a =&gt; a.V + "a", b =&gt; b.V)
				// 忽略 V1
				.Ignore(x =&gt; x.V1)
				// b.V2 = a.V
				.Map(a =&gt; a.V, b =&gt; "V2")
				// b.V3 = "666";
				.Map(a =&gt; "666", b =&gt; "V3")
				.Build();
</code></pre>
<h3 id="对象映射">对象映射</h3>
<p>有以下模型类：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">    public class TestValue
    {
        public string ValueA { get; set; } = "A";

        public string ValueB { get; set; } = "B";

        public string ValueC { get; set; } = "C";
    }

    public class TestA
    {
        public TestValue Value { get; set; }
    }
    public class TestB
    {
        public TestValue Value { get; set; }
    }
</code></pre>
<p>TestA 和 TestB 类型中，均有 TestValue 类型的属性，框架默认使用引用赋值，示例：</p>
<pre><code class="language-cs">testB.Value = testA.Value
</code></pre>
<p>两个对象的 Value 属性引用了同一个对象。</p>
<p>如果需要开辟新的实例，可以使用：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">        var mapper = new MaomiMapper();
        mapper.Bind&lt;TestA, TestB&gt;(option =&gt;
        {
            // 开辟新的实例
            option.IsObjectReference = false;
        }).Build();
</code></pre>
<p>如果两者的 Value 属性是不同类型对象，则框架也会自动映射。如：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">    public class TestA
    {
        public TestValueA Value { get; set; }
    }
    public class TestB
    {
        public TestValueB Value { get; set; }
    }
</code></pre>
<p>TestValueA、TestValueB 均为对象类型时，框架会自动映射下一层。</p>
<h3 id="数组和集合映射">数组和集合映射</h3>
<p>MaomiMapper 只能处理相同类型的数组，并且使用直接赋值的方法。</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">		public class TestA
		{
			public int[] Value { get; set; }
		}
		public class TestB
		{
			public int[] Value { get; set; }
		}
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">			var mapper = new MaomiMapper();
			mapper.Bind&lt;TestA, TestB&gt;(option =&gt;
			{
				option.IsObjectReference = true;
			}).BuildAndReverse(option =&gt;
			{
				option.IsObjectReference = false;
			});

			var a = new TestA
			{
				Value = new[] { 1, 2, 3 }
			};
			var b = mapper.Map&lt;TestA, TestB&gt;(a);
</code></pre>
<p>MaomiMapper 可以处理大多数集合，除了字典等类型。</p>
<p>处理相同类型的集合：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">		public class TestC
		{
			public List&lt;int&gt; Value { get; set; }
		}
		public class TestD
		{
			public List&lt;int&gt; Value { get; set; }
		}
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">			var mapper = new MaomiMapper();
			mapper.Bind&lt;TestC, TestD&gt;(option =&gt;
			{
				option.IsObjectReference = false;
			}).Build();

			var a = new TestA
			{
				Value = new[] { 1, 2, 3 }
			};
			var b = mapper.Map&lt;TestA, TestB&gt;(a);
</code></pre>
<p>相当于：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">d.Value = new List&lt;int&gt;();
d.Value.AddRange(c.Value);
</code></pre>
<p>也可以处理不同类型的集合：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">		public class TestE
		{
			public List&lt;int&gt; Value { get; set; }
		}
		public class TestF
		{
			public IEnumerable&lt;int&gt; Value { get; set; }
		}
		public class TestG
		{
			public HashSet&lt;int&gt; Value { get; set; }
		}
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">			var mapper = new MaomiMapper();
			mapper.Bind&lt;TestE, TestF&gt;(option =&gt;
			{
				option.IsObjectReference = false;
			}).Build();

			var a = new TestE
			{
				Value = new List&lt;int&gt; { 1, 2, 3 }
			};
			var b = mapper.Map&lt;TestE, TestF&gt;(a);
</code></pre>
<p>以上 TestE、TestF、TestG 均可互转。</p>
<h3 id="值类型互转">值类型互转</h3>
<p>框架支持以下类型自动互转。</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">Boolean
SByte
Byte
Int16
UInt16
Int32
UInt32
Int64
UInt64
Single
Double
Decimal
Char
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1315495/202604/1315495-20260417082234497-573632987.png" alt="image-20231015164629846" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>支持任何类型自动转换为 string，但是不支持 string 转换为其它类型。</p>
<p>对于时间类型的处理，可以手动配置转换函数：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">	public class TestA
	{
		public string Value { get; set; }
	}
	public class TestB
	{
		public DateTime Value { get; set; }
	}

	[Fact]
	public void AS_Datetime()
	{
		var mapper = new MaomiMapper();
		mapper.Bind&lt;TestA, TestB&gt;(option =&gt;
		{
            // 配置转换函数
			option.ConvertDateTime = value =&gt;
			{
				if (value is string str)
					return DateTime.Parse(str);
				throw new Exception("未能转换为时间");
			};
		}).Build();
		var date = DateTime.Now;
		var a = mapper.Map&lt;TestA, TestB&gt;(new TestA()
		{
			Value = date.ToString()
		});

		Assert.Equal(date.ToString("yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss"), a.Value.ToString("yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss"));
	}
</code></pre>
